responsibility: Supplies the empty implementation module for ChanConsts, whose functional role is entirely in the definition module’s shared flag and open-result type declarations. It exists to satisfy the Modula-2 module structure for the ISO channel-constants API used throughout the gm2 I/O libraries.
same_name_distinction: This is only the empty Modula-2 implementation companion for ChanConsts; unlike ChanConsts.def it introduces no flags or enums, and unlike ChanConsts.h it is not the C interoperability header that mirrors OpenResults for runtime support code.
